svg.text: 18750 Interstate 45 N, Spring, Texas · opened 2013, closed 2023 · Minecraft Java 1.21.x reconstruction
Twelve homes, ordered largest to smallest by verified 2013 square footage. Scale: 1 block ≈ 2 ft; 1 block² ≈ 4 sq ft.

svg.text: Source-verified per home: name, architectural style, square footage, bedroom / bathroom count and storey count (references/manifest.yaml REF-017, from the operator’s own Showcase-of-Homes pages).
High-confidence inference: footprint in blocks, derived arithmetically as round(sq ft ÷ 4 ÷ storeys) at 1 block² ≈ 4 sq ft (planning/buildings.yaml).

Creative approximation: every block in every palette above. No retrieved source documents any home’s facade materials, colours, roof form or window pattern (REF-019). Nothing here is a documented exterior.
† The Ashby Manor’s storey count is NOT established by evidence — REF-017 lists it as null. Two storeys is an assumption inherited from peer homes, and its footprint math depends on it.
‡ The Midtown and The Timbergrove carry more than one published square footage; the 2013 official figure is used on both cards and the alternates are named on the card face.
